name: shipment_lines
title: Shipment Lines
description: What was actually in the box. This is the collection partial fulfillment is derived FROM: cumulative shipped quantity per order line is a fold over these rows, and orders.status (partial/shipped/delivered) is a read of that fold, never a hand-maintained flag. The gate that makes the fold trustworthy lives in hook_shipment_lines: cumulative quantity across every shipment of one order line may never exceed the quantity ordered, refused with all three numbers rather than a shrug. description is STAMPED from the order line at creation so a packing slip printed next year still says what the packer put in the box, even if the product has since been renamed (docs/logic-decisions.md #1).

fields.name: shipment_id
fields.label: Shipment
fields.help: Set once at creation and not intended to change after -- not schema read_only for the same reason order_lines.order_id is not: a required, client-submitted-at-creation field cannot also be read_only on this platform.

fields.name: order_line_id
fields.label: Order Line
fields.help: Which order line this quantity satisfies. Required, and not merely a cross-reference: without it the over-shipping gate has nothing to count against, and 'we shipped three of something' is not an answer to 'did the customer get what they ordered?'. Plain text rather than a declared relation, so this package can be installed alongside an app-orders that is not there yet -- the hook does the real check and says so in words.

fields.name: product_id
fields.label: Product
fields.help: Optional cross-reference to app-catalog's products, mirroring order_lines.product_id. It is what the sale stock move is composed against; a line with no product moves no stock, which is correct for a service or a free-text line that never sat on a shelf.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.help: Stamped from the order line at creation. The packing slip prints THIS, not a live product lookup: a parcel's paperwork must keep saying what was in it.

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Quantity
fields.help: A count/measure, not money -- may be fractional, same deliberate exception order_lines.quantity documents. Read with Decimal everywhere (hook_shipment_lines, action_create_shipment, system_order_fulfillment), never a bare float.
